headline: You can now switch between the classic bags and BetterBags Next instantly without reloading your interface.

entries.title: Switch between classic bags and Next without reloading
entries.details: You can now switch between the classic bag view and BetterBags Next on the fly without needing to reload your UI. Switching is available in the settings, via the /bb next slash command, from the classic backpack menu, or using the switch button in the Next header. For safety, switching is disabled while in combat, at the bank, or visiting a vendor.
